com.renquant.rq104-degradation-sentinel.clears_when: any firing with zero alarms. Note this row no longer hides a crash: exit 3 is not acked here, and an absent or stale receipt is LOUD in the run-surface drift scan.
com.renquant.rq104-degradation-sentinel.reason: exit 1 IS the sentinel's alarm-delivered signal (by design); self-referential row. GOAL-1 #622: an uncaught exception used to exit 1 as well, so a CRASHED sentinel and an ALARMING one were the same observable and this ack covered both. A crash now exits 3, and every firing writes a liveness receipt (~/.renquant/sentinel/rq104_degradation_receipt.json, override RQ_SENTINEL_RECEIPT) whose freshness and outcome are checked by com.renquant.run-surface-drift — a separate job, because a process cannot attest to its own liveness. So this ack now covers ONLY exit 1.
